page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-44-standardlssd is a memory-optimized and storage-focused server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 44 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 22 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 352 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core. Storage is bundled directly with the instance, consisting of three local NVMe SSDs that deliver a total capacity of 9663 GB. The CPU includes advanced instruction sets such as Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) for hardware-accelerated matrix and vector operations.

Performance benchmarks show strong capabilities in specific multi-threaded and cryptographic tasks. The instance achieves a strong rating in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 230.59 GB/sec and in the Passmark CPU encryption test. Image processing performance is also strong, scoring 15894.0 on Geekbench. For machine learning workloads, the CPU's AMX instructions enable strong prompt processing speeds, reaching 2491.27 tokens/sec on small LLM models and 185.07 tokens/sec on medium models. However, text generation for larger models is a notable tradeoff, with 70B model text generation falling into the bottom 10% at 2.44 tokens/sec due to the lack of dedicated GPU hardware. General compute, memory bandwidth, and database operations perform consistently within the average range.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the z3-highmem-44-standardlssd offers high resource density by combining a substantial memory footprint with massive local NVMe SSD storage. This configuration eliminates the need for external block storage attachments for high-throughput data needs, optimizing resource-to-cost ratios for data-intensive applications. This server is highly suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, multi-threaded decompression pipelines, and localized machine learning inference on small to medium models where dedicated GPUs are not required.
